mapper.sql: SELECT f.id, f.created_at, f.kind, f.target_id, f.partner_ref, CASE f.kind WHEN 'PLAN' THEN pt.name ELSE ip.name END AS partner_name, CASE f.kind WHEN 'PLAN' THEN COALESCE(v.name, cur.name) ELSE x.name END AS target_name, v.version_no, CASE f.kind WHEN 'PLAN' THEN f.plan_type ELSE x.product_type END AS category, x.carrier, f.target_url, f.from_page, f.result FROM forward_log f LEFT JOIN partner pt ON f.kind = 'PLAN' AND pt.code = f.partner_ref LEFT JOIN plan_version v ON f.kind = 'PLAN' AND v.id = f.plan_version_id LEFT JOIN plan p ON f.kind = 'PLAN' AND p.id = f.target_id LEFT JOIN plan_version cur ON cur.id = p.published_version_id LEFT JOIN internet_product x ON f.kind = 'INTERNET' AND x.id = f.target_id LEFT JOIN internet_partner ip ON f.kind = 'INTERNET' AND ip.id::text = f.partner_ref
mapper.select: ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM forward_log f LEFT JOIN internet_product x ON f.kind = 'INTERNET' AND x.id = f.target_id

SELECT f.partner_ref AS key, COALESCE(CASE f.kind WHEN 'PLAN' THEN pt.name ELSE ip.name END, '(없음)') AS label, count(*) AS count FROM forward_log f LEFT JOIN partner pt ON f.kind = 'PLAN' AND pt.code = f.partner_ref LEFT JOIN internet_partner ip ON f.kind = 'INTERNET' AND ip.id::text = f.partner_ref WHERE f.kind = #{kind} AND f.created_at >= #{from} AND f.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
SELECT count(*) FROM forward_log WHERE kind = #{kind} AND created_at >= #{since}
